summary: Reject uncovered offline scopes, compare facility handoffs, and preserve validated origin-aware cache pairs with explicit incomplete-selection notes.
reason: A complete saved board covers only its declared source request; empty queries and automatic pairing must not imply evidence outside that scope, and facility map changes are material planning changes.
validated_outcome: Regression cases cover uncovered versus covered-empty requests, facility/map-only changes, newest compatible origins, and budget/malformed/missing older files with and without an existing pair.
